string.text: Another fool enters our domain. Surrender your gold or forfeit your life!
What do you want of me?
Who are you to approach me? Speak, my patience wears thin.
{STR_SALUTATION}... I offer you my fealty.
Halt there! Who are you? I would know whom I slay.
{STR_SALUTATION}. It has been some time.
{STR_SALUTATION}... I am yours to command.
I am at your beckon call. How may I serve?
{STR_SALUTATION}... I will make sure you remain unburied after you fall.
Say what you will, afterwards you will perish.
If you die well today, you will join my armies in death.
You stand before the blessed, yet I know not who you are to do so. Speak, or begone from my sight.
We are aware of your meagre accomplishments. What do you require from the sons and daughters of Athel Loren, mayfly?
Isha welcomes you Kin.
Greetings. What brings you before the Asrai this day?
Isha welcomes you Kin.
May Isha bless you friend. What is it?
Pray tell me what poor creature Morai-Heg has cursed unto my path.
The children of Orion and Ariel greet you. Speak quickly for i am busy.
Outlander, you waste precious time, but i will hear you. Speak. Quickly.
I thought Ereth Khial had taken you. What is it, fiend?
Lileath bids I hear your poisonous tongue, or I'd have cut it out already.
May Isha bless you friend. What is it?
Kurnous has bid us hunt today. It seems we have found it. Speak, while you can.
Eldrazor shall see battle today, if you seek it, the Asrai shall give it.
It is cruel that Khaine brings you to your death, what do you wish to say before your end.
I will hear your foul words, only yo make my vengence a sweeter offering to Drakira.
Praise Drakira! my most hated foe delivers himself to me, speak your last words then return to your army and await slaughter.
My kin argue whether you are a prize worthy of Kurnous or Anath Raema, speak while I decide which should have you.
Enemy of the Asrai, i shall not hurry the death of my kin, if you do not for yours. Let us speak.
Lileath wishes us to see the truth of people, I pray the truth of you is peaceful.
